protocol.status: DEV-only universal representation diagnostic; not a holdout claim
protocol.encoder_role: frozen DINOv2-S/14 patch descriptors used only for correspondence
protocol.anchors: all 16x16 patches in each state's common pre-action image
protocol.matching: cosine top-4; per-anchor standardized softmax barycenter; direct start-to-frame matching
protocol.geometry: normalized x/y position plus finite-difference vx/vy for every anchor
protocol.compression: per-state unlabeled PCA45 fitted to 64 probe trajectories
protocol.monitor: unchanged action branch/refinement plus proper visual-native consequence stage
protocol.resource_policy: one simulator process; Torch <=8, BLAS <=2 CPU threads
